title: Moonshine Module Interpretation of the Substrate Valuation Invariant
conjecture: The invariant 45 = v₂(|M|)-1 has a natural interpretation in terms of the graded dimensions of the Moonshine module V♮ = ⊕_n V♮_n
approach_A: Check if 45 = sum of v₂(dim V♮_n) for n in substrate prime range
approach_B: Check if 45 appears as a graded 2-adic dimension in the McKay-Thompson series for substrate classes
approach_C: The linear form 3v₂ + 3p - 2v₃ = 45 may arise from the (2,3)-bigraded structure of the Monster Lie algebra
key_question: Is there a natural Monster module M_p for each substrate prime p such that |M_p| encodes the valuation invariant?
v2_factoid: v₂(|M|) = 46 = 2 × 23. Note 23 is the largest prime in the Baby Monster but not in the substrate. The -1 shift to get 45 may reflect the weight-0 vs weight-1 vacuum distinction in V♮.
